mentions.name: librarian
mentions.description: This is a Kafka Connect alternative for database-to-Kafka replication. It currently supports MongoDB replication to Kafka via change streams, with Postgres support in development.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on a Kafka Connect alternative:

https://github.com/turbolytics/librarian

Right now mongo replication (through changestreams) is supported to kafka. Working on Postgres support right now.
